Electrical contacts or fluid fittings

Fittings, electrical contacts and connectors in copper and brass alloys.

Typical geometry
Threads, inserts, cylindrical fittings, busbars and heat-sink features.
Material options
C36000 brass, tellurium copper and other copper/brass options; confirm the alloy for your part.
Key review
Electrical contact, heat transfer and fluid sealing need different acceptance criteria. State the function before specifying the copper or brass alloy and plating.
Request a quote

Have a drawing? Add it to your inquiry email.

Manufacturing options
Materials
C36000 brass, tellurium copper and other copper/brass options; confirm the alloy for your part.
Machining
CNC turning, milling, multi-axis machining and casting finishing.
Surface finish
Specify any protective plating and the surfaces needed for electrical or thermal contact.

Made to order. Your approved drawing and quotation define the specification; the image is not a material certificate, dimensional record or inspection result.

Drawing and
inspection requirements
Quality & inspection
Geometry & interfaces
Separate contact surfaces from sealing features and specify threads, fastening details and post-finish dimensions.
Material & finish
Specify the material grade, condition, finish and any masked areas.
Quantity
State the prototype or batch quantity and required schedule.
Inspection requirements
Agree thread gauging, burr and surface acceptance. Conductivity or pressure performance needs separate test criteria.
Prepare an RFQ email

From 1 piece · 7–14 business days
From drawing and order confirmation, including surface finishing; transit is additional.
